description: Extract Capterra software profiles (pricing, features, integrations, alternatives, FAQs, media, ratings), browse category listings, search by name, and export reviews. No cookies, API keys or proxy setup needed.

_probeBrowser.description: Internal diagnostic mode. Tests the transport matrix and writes one probe record per combination; no product records are produced.
_probeBrowser.title: Diagnostic probe

_probeTransport.description: Internal. `full` tests every transport already probed; `auto` tests only the free AUTO datacenter rung.
_probeTransport.title: Diagnostic probe scope

categoryUrls.description: Capterra category pages or slugs to browse (mode=byCategoryUrls), e.g. https://www.capterra.com/team-communication-software/ or `team-communication-software`. Use spaces or hyphens in the slug.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs

fetchAllReviews.description: Also walk the dedicated reviews pages to collect more reviews than the product page shows, up to Max reviews. Adds one request per review page.
fetchAllReviews.title: Fetch more reviews

includeAlternatives.description: Attach the products Capterra lists as alternatives (name, rating, price, URL).
includeAlternatives.title: Include alternatives

includeFaqs.description: Attach the product FAQ entries shown on the Capterra profile.
includeFaqs.title: Include FAQs

includeReviews.description: Attach the latest reviews that Capterra publishes on the product page. Set false for the smallest possible run.
includeReviews.title: Include reviews

maxItems.description: Maximum number of product records to emit.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Control how many products and how much extra data each record contains.
maxItems.title: Max products

maxReviewRating.description: Keep only reviews with at most this star rating. 0 means no maximum.
maxReviewRating.title: Maximum review rating

maxReviews.description: Maximum reviews attached to each product record (used when Include reviews is on).
maxReviews.title: Max reviews per product

minReviewRating.description: Keep only reviews with at least this star rating. 0 means no minimum.
minReviewRating.title: Minimum review rating

mode.description: What to scrape. Product URLs give the full profile; search queries resolve up to 20 products per query; category URLs walk a ranked category listing.
enumTitles: Search by product or category name
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: Capterra product pages to scrape (mode=byProductUrls). Paste full URLs such as https://www.capterra.com/p/135003/Slack/ , /p/id/slug paths, or compare URLs (both products are expanded). Regional capterra.* domains are accepted.
productUrls.title: Product URLs

reviewSort.description: How attached reviews are ordered before the per-product limit is applied.
reviewSort.title: Review sort

searchQueries.description: Product names or category terms to search on Capterra (mode=bySearchQueries), e.g. `Slack`, `project management software`, `CRM`. Capterra returns up to 20 products per query.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: Order of products inside a category listing (mode=byCategoryUrls).
sortBy.title: Category sort

title: Capterra Scraper Input
